thesis: CDNA is in a strong uptrend and is consolidating after a fundamentally driven post-earnings gap. Price sits on the SMA20 and the 75.81 swing low, and the pullback came on fading volume. The balance sheet is strong, dilution risk is low, and there is no scheduled event risk. A retest of the 90.87 high gives a large reward/risk if 76-78 holds. This is a tactical, size-down long, not a high-conviction one. The risk-off regime, high beta, rich valuation and a very tight stop all argue against full size.
